  • Surinderella

Surinderella

TUE 20 - SAT 31 OCT 2026
Book
  • About
  • Booking Details

‘a delightful blend of storytelling, music, dance and humour’ (Theatre Vibe)

From the company behind Britain’s Got Bhangra, The Deranged Marriage and Pyar Actually - Surinderella is back by popular demand for 2026!

Expect an evening of laughter, romance, and larger-than-life entertainment for the whole family with this unique take on a classic pantomime story.

Meet Surinder, sweet, strong, and stuck in a never-ending chore list thanks to her two Insta-fame obsessed stepsisters, Lovely and Bubbly. Her only real support? The one and only Basanti, a cow with the dance skills of a Bollywood superstar!

Meanwhile, Prince Kavi is drowning in marriage pressure from his royal family. But when he accidentally bumps into Surinder, sparks fly.

Enter the fabulous Devi Godmother played by Harpz Kaur (BBC Asian Network, CBBC's Saturday Mash-up). She'll be arriving in full-on glam mode with magic, makeovers, and masala moves. 

With a dazzling Bollywood Ball, a mystical slipper, and a lot of drama, Surinder’s destiny is about to get a serious glow-up!

Click here for details about companion/carer tickets

School Bookings
Weekday matinee performances during school term-time are often attended by school groups.
Call Box Office on 020 8534 0310 to book tickets at £14 per person.

Group Bookings
If you buy nine standard rate tickets then you get the 10th free. Group bookings (of nine or more tickets) can only be booked over the phone or in person.

Booking Enquiries
Our online booking system doesn’t allow customers to leave isolated seats. We do this in order to prevent gaps in the auditorium.

Currently seats are on sale from Row B in the stalls, and it is possible that Row A will go on sale at a later date, so please be aware that purchasing seats in Row B does not guarantee that you will be in the front row.

Please note that our boxes have a slightly restricted view. Seats marked with an ‘i’ on the seating plan have a restricted view.

Our ticket prices increase as the theatre fills. We always recommend booking early to secure the best seats at the best price.

If you require any help with your booking then please contact our Box Office by emailing tickets@stratfordeast.com or calling 020 8534 0310.

More Information

Running Time: Approximately 2 hours including an interval.

Age guidance: 5+ (Click here for Content Advisory Notes)

Access Performances
Captioned Performance: Thu 29 Oct, 7.30pm

Members Offer
20% off for Members & Friends when you book 2 or more shows at the same time.
